criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.status: identity/OSM feature verified; source accuracy uncertain
criteria.evidence: Raw OSM way/473799725 names Redeemer Lutheran Church and tags it as a Lutheran place of worship. The official congregation contact snapshot lists 510 Lindberg Avenue, West Lafayette; the 2017 newspaper ad image identifies Redeemer Lutheran Church at Salisbury & Lindberg. The 24-vertex OSM outline is the source footprint, but it is volunteered mapping rather than survey evidence.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.status: matches source feature; geodetic accuracy not independently surveyed
criteria.evidence: Reprojected the preserved OSM ring using the documented project transform, then reproduced the 0.3 m importer point filter. The model has 24 unique grade vertices; source-to-model symmetric nearest-vertex error is 0.000120 m. Source XY bounds=[-25.91812063210944, 7.251306657117547, 2067.7868800000647, 2112.0807360001118]; model overall bounds including roofs/details=[-25.918121337890625, 7.251306533813477, 2067.786865234375, 2112.080810546875]. This confirms import consistency, not positional accuracy versus survey control.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: roof form photo-supported; heights and dimensions estimated
criteria.evidence: The source photo shows a low, one-level building with a steep gabled main volume and small side windows. OSM supplies no height or level tags and the image has no scale. Model height is 10.80 m, comprising estimated 4.8 m eaves and 10.8 m ridge; these are not measured.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The saved preview shows perimeter walls, a central gabled volume, repeated small windows, and a paired-entry marker. The low-resolution newspaper image supports a gabled form and side windows, but the front feature is indistinct and entrance/window spacing cannot be measured. Mesh face material counts: {'massing_redeemer_lutheran_church_2e5ce2f_Masonry': 26, 'massing_redeemer_lutheran_church_2e5ce2f_Glazing': 102, 'massing_redeemer_lutheran_church_2e5ce2f_Limestone': 378, 'massing_redeemer_lutheran_church_2e5ce2f_Low_Roof': 22, 'massing_redeemer_lutheran_church_2e5ce2f_Shingle_Roof': 2}.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Asset reopened in Blender 5.2.3 with stable ID/path, expected object and collection, and one mesh object (816 vertices, 530 faces). Dedicated builder, source snapshots, structured evidence, photo observation, render, and reopen validation are present=True. Materials are embedded in the mesh; no external texture dependency is required.

findings: Keep eave and ridge heights, gable placement, roof treatment for unphotographed wings, and facade dimensions marked estimated; no measured elevations or plan source was found.
The OSM-to-mesh agreement is extremely close but tests consistency with the original import, not independent survey accuracy or structural-wall registration.
The only architectural photograph is a small 2017 halftone; the central gable feature, entrance, and side-wing roof forms remain simplified or uncertain.
